scope: Repeat-lane UI inspection and pending-approval cleanup only; no full-feature closure claim.

visible_hits_rows_state.observed: The saved hits recipe displayed OK, `last run 7m ago · 10 rows`, and a 10-row table. The first row matched the visible HN story's title, author, points, and comments. This confirms the screen state and its content, not which run produced the cached rows.

second_replay_attribution.basis: The prior acceptance report records that the second run matched one request and was still checking at 09:12:39Z. The repeat-lane UI displayed only a relative `7m ago` label and 10 cached rows; it exposed no absolute timestamp or explicit completion identifier tying those rows to that second run.

stop_cancel_pending_page_load.observed: With the page-load approval pending and 0 responses captured, clicked Stop. UI showed `Replay cancelled.` and `Page-load capture cancelled.`; no approval was granted and the page was not reloaded.

panel_unmount_pending_page_load.observed: Started a second page-load request and closed the side panel while its approval was pending. The prompt and capture status disappeared on unmount; the HN page remained loaded. This covers pending approval only, not an attached debugger or active response capture.

debugger_cleanup.observed: The terminal-looking rows view and post-unmount HN page screenshots showed no Chrome debugger infobar. No debugger approval was granted during the cancellation and unmount checks.

not_exercised: Attribution of the visible 10 rows to the second replay.
Panel unmount after debugger attachment or while response capture is active.
